### Finalized TSVs
```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

raw <- read_tsv("../raw_data/raw_duplex_pileup_newPTA_altge1.tsv")
nogerm <- read_tsv("../raw_data/no_germline.no_blacklist.duplex_pileup_newPTA_altge1.tsv")
filt <- read_tsv("../raw_data/no_unrelated.no_germline.no_blacklist.duplex_pileup_newPTA_altge1_unrel_lowci.tsv")
```

## Caller wise variant annotation character
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

call_cols <- c("call_Illumina", "call_ppmSeq_multiread", "call_ppmSeq_singleton_HC", "call_UDSeq_multiread", "call_UDSeq_singleton", "call_NanoSeq_multiread", "call_NanoSeq_singleton", "call_HiDEFseq_double_stranded", "call_HiDEFseq_single_stranded", "call_PTA_singleton")
feature_cols <- c("RNA_SEQ", "CAGE", "PROCAP", "DNASE", "ATAC", "CHIP_HISTONE", "CHIP_TF", "SPLICE_SITES", "SPLICE_SITE_USAGE", "CONTACT_MAPS")

caller_df <- filt %>%
  dplyr::mutate(variant_id = paste(chr, pos, ref, alt, sep = ":")) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::all_of(call_cols), names_to = "caller", values_to = "called") %>%
  dplyr::filter(called == 1) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(caller = stringr::str_remove(caller, "^call_"))

# 2. Numeric feature summary
numeric_long <- caller_df %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::all_of(feature_cols), names_to = "feature", values_to = "value") %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(value))

numeric_summary <- numeric_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(caller, feature) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), median = median(value), q25 = quantile(value, 0.25), q75 = quantile(value, 0.75), .groups = "drop")

numeric_summary

caller_feature_results <- numeric_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(feature) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(percentile = dplyr::percent_rank(value)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(feature, caller) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_percentile = median(percentile, na.rm = TRUE),
    p = wilcox.test(
      value,
      numeric_long$value[numeric_long$feature == dplyr::first(feature) &
                         numeric_long$caller != dplyr::first(caller)],
      exact = FALSE
    )$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(feature) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(feature, dplyr::desc(median_percentile))

caller_feature_results
```




```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

plot_df <- caller_feature_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    effect = median_percentile - 0.5,
    sig = FDR < 0.05,
    size_score = -log10(pmax(FDR, 1e-300)),
    caller = factor(caller, levels = c(
      "Illumina",
      "ppmSeq_multiread", "ppmSeq_singleton_HC",
      "UDSeq_multiread", "UDSeq_singleton",
      "NanoSeq_multiread", "NanoSeq_singleton",
      "HiDEFseq_double_stranded", "HiDEFseq_single_stranded",
      "PTA_singleton"
    )),
    feature = factor(feature, levels = rev(c(
      "RNA_SEQ", "CAGE", "PROCAP", "DNASE", "ATAC",
      "CHIP_HISTONE", "CHIP_TF", "SPLICE_SITES",
      "SPLICE_SITE_USAGE", "CONTACT_MAPS"
    )))
  )

```


```{r}
caller_labels <- c(
  "Illumina" = "IlluminaSeq",
  "ppmSeq_multiread" = "ppmSeq multiread",
  "ppmSeq_singleton_HC" = "ppmSeq singleton",
  "UDSeq_multiread" = "UDSeq multiread",
  "UDSeq_singleton" = "UDSeq singleton",
  "NanoSeq_multiread" = "NanoSeq multiread",
  "NanoSeq_singleton" = "NanoSeq singleton",
  "HiDEFseq_double_stranded" = "HiDEF-seq (ds)",
  "HiDEFseq_single_stranded" = "HiDEF-seq (ss)",
  "PTA_singleton" = "PTA-Seq"
)

feature_labels <- c(
  "RNA_SEQ" = "RNA expression",
  "CAGE" = "CAGE (promoter/TSS activity)",
  "PROCAP" = "PRO-cap (active transcription initiation)",
  "DNASE" = "DNase I hypersensitivity",
  "ATAC" = "ATAC (chromatin accessibility)",
  "CHIP_HISTONE" = "Histone modification (ChIP-seq)",
  "CHIP_TF" = "TFBS (ChIP-seq)",
  "SPLICE_SITES" = "Splice-site annotation",
  "SPLICE_SITE_USAGE" = "Splice-site usage",
  "CONTACT_MAPS" = "3D contact signal"
)

plot_df2 <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    caller = factor(caller, levels = names(caller_labels), labels = unname(caller_labels)),
    feature = factor(feature, levels = names(feature_labels), labels = unname(feature_labels))
  )

ggplot(plot_df2, aes(x = caller, y = feature)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = size_score, fill = effect), shape = 21, color = NA, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_point(
    data = dplyr::filter(plot_df2, sig),
    aes(size = size_score, fill = effect),
    shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.7, alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#3B6FB6", mid = "white", high = "#C94C4C",
    midpoint = 0, limits = c(-0.35, 0.35), oob = scales::squish,
    name = "Median percentile shift"
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(2, 12),
    name = expression(-log[10]("(FDR)"))
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

### AlphaGenome enrichment w/ dendrogram
```{r}
library(ggplot2); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(scales); library(tibble)
library(ggdendro); library(patchwork)

# ===== parameters =====
bubble_min <- 1.2
bubble_max <- 5.0      # max circle size는 여기서 조정
stroke_sig <- 0.45
effect_full_lim <- c(-0.36, 0.36)

# ===== make effect matrix: rows = feature, columns = caller =====
effect_mat_col_hclust <- plot_df2 %>%
  select(feature, caller, effect) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = caller, values_from = effect) %>%
  column_to_rownames("feature") %>%
  as.matrix()

effect_mat_col_hclust[is.na(effect_mat_col_hclust)] <- 0

# ===== column hclust =====
caller_hclust <- hclust(dist(t(effect_mat_col_hclust)), method = "complete")
caller_order_col_hclust <- caller_hclust$labels[caller_hclust$order]

# ===== reverse leaf order while preserving dendrogram structure =====
caller_order_col_hclust_rev <- rev(caller_order_col_hclust)
n_caller_col_hclust <- length(caller_order_col_hclust)

plot_df2_col_hclust_rev <- plot_df2 %>%
  mutate(caller = factor(caller, levels = caller_order_col_hclust_rev))

# ===== dendrogram data + mirror flip =====
dendro_col_hclust <- ggdendro::dendro_data(caller_hclust, type = "rectangle")

dendro_segment_col_hclust_rev <- segment(dendro_col_hclust) %>%
  mutate(x = n_caller_col_hclust + 1 - x,
         xend = n_caller_col_hclust + 1 - xend)

p_dendro_col_hclust_rev <- ggplot(dendro_segment_col_hclust_rev) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend), linewidth = 0.35) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.5, n_caller_col_hclust + 0.5),
                     breaks = seq_along(caller_order_col_hclust_rev),
                     labels = caller_order_col_hclust_rev,
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_void(base_size = 9) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(2, 4, -2, 3))

# ===== bubble plot with reversed hclust order =====
p_bubble_col_hclust_rev <- ggplot(plot_df2_col_hclust_rev, aes(x = caller, y = feature)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = size_score, fill = effect), shape = 21, color = NA, alpha = 0.95) +
  geom_point(data = filter(plot_df2_col_hclust_rev, sig), aes(size = size_score, fill = effect),
             shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = stroke_sig, alpha = 0.95) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("#4575B4", "#A6CEE3", "#F7F7F7", "#F4A582", "#D73027"),
                       values = rescale(c(-0.36, -0.10, 0, 0.10, 0.36)),
                       limits = effect_full_lim, oob = squish,
                       name = "Median percentile shift") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(bubble_min, bubble_max),
                        name = expression(-log[10]("(FDR)"))) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = caller_order_col_hclust_rev, expand = expansion(add = 0.5)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 8.5, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8.5, color = "black"),
        axis.line = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8.3),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7.8),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.35, "cm"),
        plot.margin = margin(0, 4, 3, 3))

# ===== combined plot =====
p_col_hclust_with_dendro_rev <- p_dendro_col_hclust_rev / p_bubble_col_hclust_rev +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.22, 1))

p_col_hclust_with_dendro_rev
```

dir.create("../output", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("../output/ext_data_fig2_genomic_feature_bubbleplot.pdf",
       plot = p_col_hclust_with_dendro_rev,
       width = 9.2, height = 3.1, units = "in",
       device = cairo_pdf, bg = "white")
